name: B-4D Legion
description: The B-4D Legion was a model of bomber produced by the shipyards at the planet Sernpidal for the reconstituted Sith Empire. Primarily a drone bomber, the Legion utilized missile sentry drones, laser cannons, and proton torpedoes to attack enemies, and was used by Imperial forces during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

data.name: B-4D Legion
armament: Proton torpedoes, concussion missiles, or seeker mines
Missile sentry drone, interdiction sentry drone, or railgun sentry drone
